        """Find all dollar amounts in the email body.

        amounts = []

        match = self._reference_pattern.search(self.email.body)
        if match:
            ref = match.group('ref')
            logger.debug("Extracted booking reference: %s", ref)
            return ref
        logger.debug("No booking reference found.")
        return None

        """Parse departure and arrival times from the email body.

        times = {}
